edges: Andreas Lubitz locked the captain out of the cockpit and caused the plane's crash.
The crash of Germanwings Flight 9525 resulted in the death of all 150 people on board.
Lufthansa confirmed that Andreas Lubitz had battled depression before the crash.
Christoph Kumpa revealed that medical records indicate Lubitz suffered from suicidal tendencies.
Lubitz's girlfriend informed investigators about his recent visits to doctors who deemed him unfit to work.
Andreas Lubitz was employed by Lufthansa and had a history of depression.
Christoph Kumpa revealed details about Andreas Lubitz's mental health history.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The crash of Germanwings Flight 9525 occurred near Marseille, France.
